verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC screening and monitoring platform, so a no-code verification link or QR code is a fair question for it. The evidence covers API-driven customer creation and screening, plus web-app case review. Nothing shows a shareable hosted link or QR code that an ops lead could send to a customer, contractor, or seller without engineering work.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can send a verification to someone with a no-code link or QR code — no engineering ticket to verify a one-off customer, contractor, or seller
